newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices bounce back after losses.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices bounce back after losses.

text.p: Indian cotton prices on Friday bounced back after recent losses, dealers said.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by 10/20 rupees at 1,040/1,090 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned rose by 15 rupees at 1,840/1,900 rupees and F-414 rose by 20 rupees at 2,080/2,100 rupees per maund.
"Short-covering by the exporters who have earlier sold forward cotton to foreign buyers also helped prices to bounce back," one broker said.
Gujarat Kalyan lifted by 300 rupees at 14,200/14,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while Kala-ginned rose by 300/400 rupees at 12,600 rupees per candy.
